question: 2025 年第一季的淨營收是多少？
gt_sql: WITH vo AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2025-04-01' ) SELECT ROUND((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents),0)/100.0 FROM order_items oi JOIN vo ON vo.order_id=oi.order_id) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount_twd),0) FROM refunds r JOIN vo ON vo.order_id=r.order_id), 2)

question: 2025 年 6 月的客單價是多少？
gt_sql: WITH vo AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-06-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2025-07-01' ) SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents)/100.0/COUNT(DISTINCT vo.order_id),2) FROM vo JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=vo.order_id

question: 歷史上哪個商品類別的退款金額最高？
gt_sql: SELECT p.category FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id=r.item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 北部客戶在 2025 年共有多少張有效訂單？
gt_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2026-01-01' AND c.region_code='TW-N'

question: 2025 年有多少位回購客戶？
gt_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) c FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING c>=2)

question: 2025 年有效訂單中，透過行動 App 下單的占比是多少（%）？
gt_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(o.channel='app')/COUNT(*),1) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2026-01-01'

question: 哪一種付款方式的實收金額最高？
gt_sql: SELECT method FROM payments WHERE payment_status='ok' GROUP BY method ORDER BY SUM(amount_twd) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 黃金會員在 2025 年的淨營收是多少？
gt_sql: WITH vo AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2026-01-01' AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE tier='G')) SELECT ROUND((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents),0)/100.0 FROM order_items oi JOIN vo ON vo.order_id=oi.order_id) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount_twd),0) FROM refunds r JOIN vo ON vo.order_id=r.order_id), 2)

question: 2025 年 9 月的退款金額總計是多少？
gt_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount_twd),0) FROM refunds WHERE datetime(refund_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-09-01' AND datetime(refund_ts,'+8 hours') < '2025-10-01'

question: 目前仍在售的商品中，銷售數量最多的是哪一個？
gt_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND p.is_active=1 GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1
